John plans to sell all his toys, but he ends up only selling some of his 13 Lego sets. He uses the money to buy 8 video games at $20 each and has $5 left.  
The total money spent and remaining is:  
8 × $20 + $5 = $160 + $5 = $165.  
Since each Lego set sells for $15, the number of sets he sold is:  
$165 ÷ $15 = 11 sets.  
He originally had 13 sets, so he still has:  
13 - 11 = 2 Lego sets.

Answer: 2
